sections.content: Use the conditional to propose possible responses: cambiaría, invertiría, *buscaría*, aplicaría. Use si + imperfect subjunctive + conditional for hypothetical solutions.

items.spanish: Buscaría una alternativa si la primera solución no funcionara.
items.english: I would look for an alternative if the first solution did not work.

items.spanish: Si tuviéramos más tiempo, aplicaríamos otra medida.
items.english: If we had more time, we would implement another measure.

items.spanish: Una solución viable reduciría el problema.
items.english: A viable solution would reduce the problem.

items.spanish: ¿Qué harías si esta propuesta no fuera viable?
items.english: What would you do if this proposal were not feasible?

sections.content: Present a possible solution, then explain the condition under which you would use it.
